pois.label: 环形梯田（内高外低）
pois.detail: 三圈梯田从外到内逐级抬高:外圈叶菜(矮)、中圈番茄豆类(中)、内圈块茎与谷物试验田(高)。抬升角度按 Jezero 冬至正午太阳高度算——最矮的作物也晒得到最斜的光。
pois.detail_en: Three rings step upward from rim to center: leafy greens outside (short), tomatoes and legumes in the middle, tubers and trial grain inside (tall). The step angle was set by the noon solar elevation at Jezero's winter solstice - even the shortest crop catches the lowest light.

specs.轮作: 叶菜 30 天 / 番茄 75 天 / 马铃薯 90 天

specs_en.Area: ~320 m2 of beds across three rings
specs_en.Rotation: greens 30 d / tomato 75 d / potato 90 d

pois.sim: 产量账:马铃薯在受控环境 ~25 t/ha·季 → 内环试验田折合 ~0.9 t/季;全穹合计热量供给 ~6 人份主粮 + 全城叶菜——温室管「新鲜」,主力口粮仍靠地下城水培墙扩产。
pois.sim_en: Yield ledger: controlled-environment potato runs ~25 t/ha per season - the inner ring nets ~0.9 t. The dome altogether covers staple calories for ~6 people plus greens for the whole town: it owns freshness while the undercity's hydroponic walls scale the staples.
pois.physics: 环形梯田是把「行距遮挡」问题旋转对称化:直排温室的南北遮挡在这里变成了半径方向的高度差,任何太阳方位角都成立。
pois.physics_en: Ring terracing rotates the row-shading problem into symmetry: what a straight greenhouse solves per-azimuth, the radial height gradient solves for every sun angle at once.

pois.label: 土层剖面（洗盐 regolith）
pois.detail: 梯田端头特意切开:上层是洗过的 regolith 混堆肥,中层砾石导水,底层防渗膜。火星原土含 ~0.5 wt% 高氯酸盐,对人有毒——先水洗(洗出液送电解产氧),再接种地球带来的菌群,才成为「土」。
pois.detail_en: The bed ends are cut open on purpose: washed regolith blended with compost on top, a gravel drain layer, an impermeable liner below. Raw Martian dirt carries ~0.5 wt% perchlorate, toxic to humans - it is water-washed (the brine goes to electrolysis for oxygen), then inoculated with imported microbiota, before it earns the name soil.

specs.上层: 洗盐 regolith + 堆肥接菌
specs.底层: 防渗膜(水一滴不还给火星)

specs_en.Top: washed regolith with compost and microbes
specs_en.Bottom: impermeable liner - not one drop returned to Mars

sim: 洗盐账:每吨土约需 2 m³ 洗水,但洗出的高氯酸盐溶液电解反而产 O₂ 和盐酸原料——毒物在账本上翻成了资源,这一步由 ISRU 化学线代工。

堆肥来源补记：res-recycle-01 堆肥反应器，9.44 t/火星年（干粪+不可食生物量+厨余+纤维素调理料，C/N 配到 27，55~65 °C 灭菌 3 天）；按掺 10 wt%、上层 0.3 m 计，每火星年可新建 210 m² 苗床——现有 320 m² 约 1.5 个火星年翻一倍。洗出液蒸干后的高氯酸盐残盐送 res-eclss-01 脱除支线：Mg(ClO₄)₂ → MgCl₂ + 4O₂ 放热分解，0.573 kg O₂/kg 盐，边际电耗 0.24 kWh/kg O₂。
sim_en: Washing ledger: about 2 m3 of water per tonne of soil, but electrolyzing the perchlorate brine yields O2 and HCl feedstock - the poison flips into a resource, subcontracted to the ISRU chemical line.

Compost provenance, on the books at last: the res-recycle-01 compost reactor, 9.44 t per Mars year (dried solids, inedible biomass, kitchen waste and cellulose bulking, C/N tuned to 27, pasteurised 3 days at 55-65 C). At 10 wt% blend and a 0.3 m top layer that builds 210 m2 of new beds per Mars year - the existing 320 m2 doubles in about 1.5 Mars years. The wash-out perchlorate salt, dried, goes to the res-eclss-01 strip line: Mg(ClO4)2 to MgCl2 + 4 O2, exothermic, 0.573 kg O2 per kg of salt at 0.24 kWh/kg O2 marginal.
pois.physics: 高氯酸盐是强氧化剂,却也是氧的仓库:ClO₄⁻ 里四个氧原子等着被电化学赎回。火星农业的第一步不是播种,是解毒——而解毒本身有产出。
pois.physics_en: Perchlorate is an aggressive oxidizer - and an oxygen warehouse: four oxygen atoms per ClO4- waiting for electrochemical ransom. Martian farming starts not with sowing but with detox, and the detox pays.

pois.label: 中央灌溉塔与旋转喷灌臂
pois.detail: 塔顶水箱重力配水,双侧喷灌臂两分钟转一圈,滴头对准每一环的根区——中心一根轴喂全场,管路最短、无死角。臂上同时挂补光灯环:白天转的是水,晚上转的是光。
pois.detail_en: The tower tank feeds by gravity; the twin booms sweep once every two minutes, drip heads addressing each ring's root zone - one axis waters the whole floor with minimum pipe and no dead corner. The boom doubles as the light ring's mount: by day it turns water, by night it turns light.

specs.配水: 塔顶水箱重力供,滴灌为主
specs.补光: 暖白 + 洋红交替灯环(尘暴季主力)

specs_en.Water: gravity from the tower tank, drip-first
specs_en.Lights: alternating warm-white and magenta ring - storm-season mainstay

pois.sim: 灌溉账:滴灌把蒸发损失压到喷淋的 1/5;穹内闭环回收后,每公斤蔬菜的净水成本 ~2 L——地球露天农业的 1/100 量级。
pois.sim_en: Irrigation ledger: drip cuts evaporative loss to a fifth of spray; with the dome's closed recovery, net water cost lands near 2 L per kilogram of produce - two orders below open-field Earth farming.
pois.physics: 中心枢轴灌溉是地球圆田(center-pivot)的火星回声——几何没变,变的是水价:在地球它省人力,在火星它省的是用井寿命计价的水。
pois.physics_en: Center-pivot irrigation is Earth's crop circles echoing on Mars - same geometry, different economics: on Earth it saves labor, here it saves water priced in well-life.

pois.label: 授粉扇（这里没有蜜蜂）
pois.detail: 火星没有蜜蜂——番茄豆类靠气流与振动授粉:立扇制造脉动风,巡检时再用振动棒逐株补点。叶菜和块茎根本不需要授粉,这正是首批作物名单的隐藏筛选条件之一。
pois.detail_en: There are no bees on Mars - tomatoes and legumes are pollinated by airflow and vibration: the fans pulse the canopy, and inspection rounds touch up stubborn trusses with a vibrating wand. Greens and tubers need no pollination at all, which quietly shaped the first-crop shortlist.

specs.方式: 脉动气流 + 手持振动棒
specs.免授粉作物: 叶菜/马铃薯(名单筛选条件)

specs_en.Method: pulsed airflow plus handheld vibration wand

pois.sim: 坐果账:番茄自花授粉,只需 6-8 Hz 的花序振动即可释放花粉;气流+振动组合坐果率 ~85%,与温室蜂授粉差距 <10%——不值得为此维持一个昆虫生态。
pois.sim_en: Fruit-set ledger: tomato is self-fertile and needs only 6-8 Hz truss vibration to shed pollen; airflow plus wand reaches ~85% set, within 10% of bumblebee service - not worth maintaining an insect ecology for.
pois.physics: 花药是个音叉:共振频率附近的振动让花粉逃逸最大化——大黄蜂的「嗡」就是生物进化出的定频激振器,这里用电机复刻。
pois.physics_en: An anther is a tuning fork: vibration near resonance maximizes pollen release - a bumblebee's buzz is evolution's fixed-frequency shaker, replayed here by a motor.

pois.label: 环控（温湿度与天光）
pois.detail: 温湿度桩组成穹内的传感网;白天膜透阳光,天光膜内衬把光散匀;夜里外面 -80 ℃,双层气枕加中央补光把棚温托在 18 ℃ 以上。穹壳凝结的水珠顺膜滑进环槽——夜里的「露水」也是账上的资产。
pois.detail_en: The climate stakes form the dome's sensor net. By day the skin admits sunlight, the liner diffusing it evenly; by night, with -80 C outside, the double cushions and center lights hold the canopy above 18 C. Condensation slides down the skin into the ring gutter - even the night dew is on the books.

specs.保温: 双层 ETFE 气枕 + 层间干 CO₂
specs.传感: 温湿度桩网 + 膜面结露监测

specs_en.Insulation: double ETFE cushions with dry CO2 gap

pois.sim: 热账:⌀26 m 穹夜间散热 ~90 kW(U≈0.9 W/m²K 双层气枕),由补光废热+电加热兜底——农业穹顶的夜间电耗与它的灯几乎同量级,这笔账在电网侧合并计提。
pois.sim_en: Heat ledger: the 26 m dome loses ~90 kW on a cold night (U ~ 0.9 W/m2K for double cushions), covered by lamp waste heat plus trim heaters - a farm dome's night power is the same order as its lights, booked jointly on the grid side.
pois.physics: 温室效应本尊:膜对可见光透明、对热红外半透明,加上气枕断对流——在一颗大气薄到留不住热的行星上,人造温室效应是农业存在的前提。
pois.physics_en: The greenhouse effect itself: a skin transparent to visible light, translucent to thermal infrared, with cushions killing convection - on a planet whose atmosphere is too thin to hold heat, the artificial greenhouse effect is agriculture's precondition.
